caveats: An agency named in a political-file document placed that buy; what committees paid it in the state filings can include production and consulting as well as airtime. `media` is the part whose description says TV, television, broadcast, air time or a media buy.
Federal campaigns report to the FEC, not the state, so an agency that buys only for federal candidates shows political-file orders and no state payments.

Agencies not named in a political-file document are listed only when committees paid them at least $100,000 for described media work, and never if they sell time themselves (cable, satellite and station groups).
